# codeMicro

codeMicro is the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Directory and Developer Platform.

## Overview
codeMicro helps developers discover, integrate, and deploy MCP servers. The platform provides a searchable directory, interactive documentation, and a JSON-RPC playground.

## Key Sections
- Directory: https://www.codemicro.dev/directory
- Documentation: https://www.codemicro.dev/docs
- Pricing: https://www.codemicro.dev/pricing
- Playground: https://www.codemicro.dev/tools
- Security: https://www.codemicro.dev/security

## Protocols
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- JSON-RPC 2.0
